test_title: PYST 1: DP Head Constable (AWO/TPO) 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 27 Oct 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the given sets.

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is NOT allowed)

(428, 377, 51) 

(679, 458, 221)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

(428, 377, 51)

__428 - 377__ = 51

51 = 51 (LHS = RHS)

And,

(679, 458, 221)

__679 - 458__ = 221

221 = 221 (LHS = RHS)

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) (321, 270, 45)

__321 - 270__ = 45

51 ≠ 45 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 2) (728, 569, 160)

__728 - 569__ = 160

159 ≠ 160 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 3) (237, 86, 194)

__237 - 86__ = 194

151 ≠ 194 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 4) (1236, 788, 448)

__1236 - 788__ = 448

**448 = 448 (LHS = RHS)**

Thus, out of all the options '(1236, 788, 448)' follows the same logic as given.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
